mechanism: Alcohol increases hepatic metabolism of lopinavir via CYP3A4 induction, reducing drug levels, while both agents cause CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk is elevated in patients with liver disease or HCV/HBV coinfection.
action: Counsel patients to minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; monitor viral load and CD4 counts more frequently if alcohol use occurs, as subtherapeutic lopinavir levels may compromise antiretroviral efficacy.
